name: Membrane bioreactor (MBR) wastewater treatment
applications: water recycling for irrigation and industry
principle: A membrane bioreactor replaces the secondary clarifier of an activated-sludge plant with a submerged ultrafiltration/microfiltration membrane unit inside (or immediately after) the bioreactor. Mixed liquor is filtered directly at 0.1-0.4 um, giving a solids-free, turbidity-low effluent ready for disinfection or RO reuse, at a much smaller footprint and higher mixed-liquor concentration (8-15 g/L MLSS typical). Per licensor-first rule this card follows the Kubota Submerged Membrane Unit (SMU) flat-plate configuration published by Kubota Water & Environment: coarse screening to fine screening, equalisation, anoxic/aerobic bioreactor, submerged flat-plate membrane tank with coarse-bubble air scour, permeate drawn at low trans-membrane pressure, and in-tank membrane cleaning by backwash with chlorine and periodic recovery chemical clean.

process_steps.name: Screening and equalisation
equipment: fine screen (1-3 mm) to protect flat plates

process_steps.name: Biological oxidation (anoxic + aerobic zones)
equipment: anoxic zone with mixing for denitrification

process_steps.name: Submerged membrane filtration (Kubota SMU flat plates)
equipment: flat-plate membrane cartridges immersed in the membrane tank
permeate pump at low trans-membrane pressure
